## How to use this family

- [`hardwaredevice`](/api/resources/hardwaredevice/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `type_json`.
- [`hardwaredeviceapproval`](/api/resources/hardwaredeviceapproval/): `type` selects the type; each log entry added through the entry actions is validated against it.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/HardwareDevice/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/HardwareDevice/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/HardwareDevice/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Data acquisition

### Amplifier

- type code `Amplifier` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/HardwareDevice/Amplifier/1.0.0.json)

An amplifier product for electrophysiological signals, described by its nominal specifications such as channel count, gain range, bandwidth, input impedance and noise level. Individual units in a lab's setups are documented as equipment that refers to this entry.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `productId` | Product ID | text |  |  | A unique product identifier for the amplifier as defined by the supplier. |
| `nChannels` | Number of Channels | number |  | ≥ 1 | Number of input channels supported by the amplifier. |
| `gain` | Gain Range | text |  |  | Amplification gain range (e.g., '1x - 10,000x', '1000x'). |
| `bandwidth` | Bandwidth | text |  |  | Frequency bandwidth of the amplifier (e.g., 'DC - 10 kHz', '0.1 Hz - 7.5 kHz'). |
| `inputImpedance` | Input Impedance | text |  |  | Input impedance specification (e.g., '>10 GΩ', '1 MΩ'). |
| `noiseLevel` | Noise Level | text |  |  | Noise level specification (e.g., '<3 µV RMS', '2.4 µV RMS'). |
| `powerSupply` | Power Supply | text |  |  | Power supply requirements (e.g., '+/- 15V', '5V USB', 'Battery'). |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "productId": "text",
    "nChannels": 1.0
}
```

- type code `ExternalIdentifiers` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/HardwareDevice/ExternalIdentifiers/1.0.0.json)
